senses.d: Having a feeling arising from a consciousness of well-being or of enjoyment; enjoying good of any kind, such as comfort, peace, or tranquillity; blissful, contented, joyous.
ex: Music makes me feel happy.
Happye are thy men, and happie are these thy seruantes[…]

senses.d: Experiencing the effect of favourable fortune; favored by fortune or luck; fortunate, lucky.
Elect or saved after death, blessed.
ex: How fares it with the happy dead?

senses.d: Content, willing, satisfied (with or to do something); having no objection (to something).
ex: Are you happy to pay me back by the end of the week?

senses.d: Bringing or being an instance of favourable fortune; apt, felicitous, fortunate, propitious.

senses.d: Favoring or inclined to use.

senses.d: Dexterous, ready, skilful.

senses.d: A happy event, thing, person, etc.
